title: Influencers in Mexico work for drug groups – level 1
paragraphs: Drug gangs in Mexico are using social media. They want to show off and fight each other.

Back in 2024, a big gang breaks into two groups. Now, they are fighting for control. They use young online stars to make videos and bring in new people. But this is very dangerous. At least 19 creators die. Some creators talk about gang life only to get views. Others help hide dirty money in normal businesses.
The police do not stop the killers. The danger keeps growing. Social media companies try to block bad accounts, but it is not enough to keep young people safe.

words.d: to show something proudly to make others like or support you
to put something in a place where nobody can see it
a situation when something bad may happen
